subproblem.title: A minimizing current with density invariant along an (n−1)-plane has support in an n-plane (Simon 7.3.3(2), (8)–(10))
subproblem.statement: Assume (CS): Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn S univ) with ∂S = 0, and let L ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with d := dim L < n. Assume the density function of S is invariant under the maps w ↦ y + λw (y ∈ L, λ > 0): whenever HasMassDensity S w θ, also HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ. Then: (a) S is a cone (IsConeCurrent S); (b) S is invariant under translations by L: S(ω(· + v)) = S(ω), i.e. currentEval (blowUp S (−v) 1) ω = S ω, for v ∈ L and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P); (c) there is S₀ ∈ 𝒟_{n−d}(ℝ^P) which is minimizing in ℝ^P, has ∂S₀ = 0, is a cone, has spt S₀ ⊆ L^⊥, and satisfies, for all t ∈ L and y ∈ L^⊥: t + y ∈ spt S ⟺ y ∈ spt S₀, and HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ⟺ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ for every θ ∈ ℝ. (For d ≥ 1, S = [[L]] × S₀.) Assume (ODC): Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ) with ∂C = 0 and C a cone (IsConeCurrent C: η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0). Then there are e ∈ ℝ^P and m ∈ ℕ such that |e| = 1 whenever m > 0, spt C ⊆ ℝe = span{e}, and Θ^1(μ_C, y) = m (HasMassDensity C y m) for every y ∈ ℝe. (In fact C = m[[ℝe]] up to orientation, or C = 0 with m = 0.) Then for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and every linear subspace L ⊆ ℝ^P with n ≤ P and dim L + 1 = n: if S is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn S univ), ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S), and HasMassDensity S w θ implies HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ for all y ∈ L, λ > 0, w ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ, then there is an n-dimensional linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P with spt S ⊆ Q.
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → IsConeCurrent S ∧ (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω) ∧ ∃ S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), IsMinimizingIn S₀ univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S₀ ∧ IsConeCurrent S₀ ∧ S₀.support ⊆ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, (t + y ∈ S.support ↔ y ∈ S₀.support)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ θ : ℝ, (HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ↔ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ)) → (∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (m : ℕ), (0 < m → ‖e‖ = 1) ∧ C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ {e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {e}, HasMassDensity C y m) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), n ≤ P → Module.finrank ℝ L + 1 = n → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ S.support ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof step 4 (exclusion of d = n − 1: 'By the sibling result cone_splitting … spt S ⊆ L + span{e}, a subspace of dimension ≤ n, contained in some n-dimensional subspace Π'''), i.e. Simon 7.3.3, proof of 3.3(2), (8)–(10) (chapter-07.txt lines 556–575: Lemma 3.5 and the form m[[ℓ]] of 1-dimensional minimizing cones). The hypotheses (CS) and (ODC) are the frozen types of the sibling children cone_splitting (Submission.idtp_fons_invariant_cone_splitting) and one_dim_cones (Submission.idtp_fons_one_dim_minimizing_cone); these types are byte-identical to those of the DAG nodes dimred_invariant_cone_splitting and dimred_one_dim_minimizing_cone. The selected node's assembly applies this child to those two siblings and passes the conclusion to the sibling cone_class as its hypothesis (PS).
1. Since dim L + 1 = n, dim L < n. Apply (CS) to (P, n, S, L) with the minimality, ∂S = 0 and invariance hypotheses. It gives S₀ ∈ 𝒟_{n − dim L}(ℝ^P), minimizing in ℝ^P, with ∂S₀ = 0, a cone, spt S₀ ⊆ L^⊥, and, for all t ∈ L and y ∈ L^⊥, t + y ∈ spt S ⟺ y ∈ spt S₀.
2. In ℕ, n − dim L = 1. Transport S₀ along this equality of degrees to S₁ ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) (in Lean: generalize d := n − dim L together with S₀ and substitute d = 1); minimality, BoundaryVanishes, IsConeCurrent and the support are unchanged, so S₁ is minimizing in ℝ^P, ∂S₁ = 0, S₁ is a cone and spt S₁ = spt S₀.
3. Apply (ODC) to S₁: there are e ∈ ℝ^P and m ∈ ℕ with spt S₁ ⊆ span{e}.
4. Let M := L ⊔ span{e}. Then dim M ≤ dim L + dim span{e} ≤ (n − 1) + 1 = n. Let w ∈ spt S. Put t := p_L(w) ∈ L (orthogonal projection L.starProjection, Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem) and y := w − t ∈ L^⊥ (Submodule.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal). Then t + y = w ∈ spt S, so y ∈ spt S₀ = spt S₁ ⊆ span{e} (steps 1–3), and w = t + y ∈ M. Hence spt S ⊆ M.
5. Since dim M ≤ n ≤ P = dim ℝ^P, there is a linear subspace Q ⊇ M with dim Q = n: starting from M, as long as the current subspace M' has dim M' < n ≤ P we have M' ≠ ℝ^P, so we may pick v ∉ M' and replace M' by M' ⊔ span{v}, whose dimension is dim M' + 1; after n − dim M steps the dimension is n. Then spt S ⊆ M ⊆ Q, as claimed. ∎
proof_key_steps: cone_splitting with dim L = n − 1 < n gives a 1-dimensional minimizing cone S₀ with t + y ∈ spt S ⟺ y ∈ spt S₀ (t ∈ L, y ∈ L^⊥).
After transporting S₀ to degree 1, one_dim_cones gives spt S₀ ⊆ span{e}.
Orthogonal decomposition w = p_L(w) + (w − p_L(w)) puts spt S inside L ⊔ span{e}, of dimension ≤ n ≤ P, which extends to an n-dimensional Q.

audit.reason: CS and ODC are explicit hypotheses, subsequently discharged by the parent. Degree transport gives a one-dimensional factor; orthogonal decomposition places the support in L ⊔ span{e}. The stated n ≤ P hypothesis justifies extension to an n-plane.
